correctness.rationale: The unital trace kernel W=ker(tr L) is a canonical two-plane since tr L_1=3. Every multiplication is uniquely a pair (mu,phi) with mu traceless symmetric W-valued and phi arbitrary symmetric scalar-valued. The explicit beta/3 and gamma/3 reconstruction proves the bijection mu <-> binary cubic with determinant twist, p>3. Frobenius-stable unordered root triples give exactly three rational GL2 orbits of squarefree cubics and exact stabilizers S3,C2,C3; the 1-dimensional scalar freedom lifts each compatible projective permutation uniquely. Their actions on Sym^2(W*) have invariant dimensions 3,2,1 as used; counting disjoint stabilizer strata gives the formulas and total q^3+q^2+q. The supplied checker independently enumerates all cubic orbits, stabilizers and symmetric forms for p=5,7,11, and directly tests cubic/endomorphism covariance. Finite tests are corroboration, not universal proof.

value.rationale: The open nonzero-discriminant locus is a canonical, geometrically generic stratum of unital commutative 3-dimensional multiplication structures. Complex normal forms do not enumerate finite-field forms; Frobenius arithmetic produces three natural types, and their simultaneous symmetric-form stabilizers yield an exact natural invariant (q^3+q^2+q) and complete full automorphism-group census. This is a structural classification across every finite field of characteristic >3, not a routine lookup or arbitrary narrow slice; it identifies precisely the rigid and symmetry-rich strata.
